value.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for polyhierarchical capability ontologies, typed tool and MCP intelligence cards, bounded multi-generation seed digestion and Pareto benchmark ranking
value.lets_workers: Maintain cycle-free polyhierarchical capability DAGs where tools belong simultaneously to multiple functional niches and runtime footprints (for example ocr_document_intelligence, pii_redaction_and_privacy and runs_on_small_4gb_laptop), normalize AI tools, MCP servers, feeds, durable queues, architecture patterns and OSS releases with canonical I/O-port signature hashes, digest root seeds one bounded hop at a time (generation_depth + 1) into /q/submit-compatible task_objects and queued_verbs, rank candidates on a 7-axis Pareto frontier under NodeGrid regimes and synthesize deterministic 4-beat component demos.

flow.when: Digest a root or intermediate capability seed by one bounded hop (generation_depth + 1), deduplicating near-duplicate branches via shingle Jaccard and preserving parent_task_id and source_task_id.
Validate AI tool, MCP server, feed and queue intelligence cards, compute canonical I/O-port SHA-256 signatures and group interchangeable candidates.
Harvest new open-source releases, papers and hackathon patterns and diff I/O signatures, licenses, RAM footprints and MCP tool lists against prior cards.
Execute head-to-head micro-benchmark scoring across cost, sub-10ms p99 latency, 4GB laptop fit, zero-dep maintainability, Kubernetes readiness, accuracy and demo reproducibility.
Synthesize a deterministic 4-beat runnable component demo and failure-mode walkthrough for top-ranked niche tools.
